PMC HMI v0.10.11 · Visual Review

27 source-based reconstructions at 480 × 272, representing states and screens from PR #14 (commit e5435e8). Not screenshots from the native LVGL renderer. Coordinates, labels and palette are taken from firmware; typography and readings are representative. Click any screen to enlarge. No repository changes were made.

27 screens

Home — not homed

Clear homing call-to-action; pressure remains dominant.

Home — manual

Best screen overall. Readings are prominent, target and Go to affordances need clearer separation.

Home — moving

Movement confirmation replaces the useful sparkline.

Home — fault

Fault priority is clear, but stop and fault messages compete for attention.

Home — numeric limits

Extreme requested values fit, but chart/scale representations should be tested across range.

Menu

Simple grouped categories; no commissioning clutter on the Home screen.

Valve — manual

Well organised controls, but 40 px hold buttons deserve bench testing.

Valve — not homed

Disabled targets are explicit; available unhomed jogging needs care.

Trend — 10 min

Legible axes and range controls; narrow plot and no y-axis interaction.

Homing — idle

Clear state and sequence.

Homing — active

The current stage is visually emphasised.

Faults and log

Fault visibility good; event log extremely small.

Fault detail

Good action-oriented recovery hierarchy with dense descriptions.

Diagnostics

Consistent 3×3 commissioning matrix, compact but useful.

Go to — keypad

Large keys, side live value; no initially obvious cancel except Back.

Homing — confirmation

Safety prompt is quite wordy, three actions constrained.

Settings landing

Clear hierarchy, but engineering overrides too close to navigation.

Cryostat name

Functional but extremely compressed keyboard at native pixels.

Choose sensor

Sensor selection and calibration status exposed logically.

Sensor calibration

3 columns of small readings; high information density.

Valve setup — valve tab

Two parameters use little of the available field space.

Valve setup — homing tab

Clear settings, plenty of room.

Valve setup — drive tab

Compact but scannable parameter grid.

Control tuning

Six adjustable fields: consistent yet hard to quickly compare.

Review and save

Excellent concept; 2-line Save/Discard labels and crowded action rail.

Motor override

Different visual language and many small touch targets.

Help overlay

Readable, but large vertical scrolling controls and overlay state.
